integrity: Finite quadrature is supporting evidence, not the proof; the exact theorem is proved analytically from monomial gamma integrals and a symmetry-block decomposition.
scientific_limitations: Pure degree three on the positive surface octant of S^2 only; no arbitrary spherical triangles, low-pass bands, noisy sensing or discrete sampling theorem. Historical priority remains provisional and an unindexed equivalent calculation is possible.
title: Sharp cubic spherical-harmonic concentration on an octant: a double optimal eigenspace
